raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 delivered 90 transactions in EUR, and silver_transactions sums their native amounts as if they were USD, so the gold USD totals are misstated. raw_fx_rates has exactly one rate per currency (EUR = 1.25 to USD), so the amounts can be converted to USD in silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount * fx.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates fx ON fx.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
